completeness.why: Four sites replace their inline missing/number/range ternary with a plain call to the existing getScheduledAmount and pass only their raw value. schedule-template.ts runSchedule is untouched and keeps its own op-dispatched 'halve the rounded sum' copy. That is presumably to preserve the listed rounding inconsistency, but the decision is still made locally rather than carried as an explicit variation of the shared definition.

interface.why: It reuses the existing exported getScheduledAmount(amount, inverse) with no speculative options. The one preserved inconsistency (the template's rounding) is not made explicit as a parameter, though: it survives only as an untouched copy.

disguised_duplication.where: The removed ternaries are deleted outright and replaced by calls to the helper. The remaining copy in schedule-template.ts is left as it was, not reshaped.
